subject: Handle dts emit time errors for incremental scenarios and buildInfo (#56295)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Caches and reports declaration emit diagnostics across incremental builds and persists buildInfo emit state, fixing dts generation errors not being reported in incremental/tsbuild scenarios.

unittests:: tsbuild:: declarationEmit:: tsc -b --explainFiles --listEmittedFiles --v declarationEmit:: multiFile/reports dts generation errors with incremental baseline for the tsc compiles

unittests:: tsbuildWatch:: watchMode:: programUpdates:: reports errors in all projects on incremental compile when declaration emit errors are present programUpdates reportErrors/declarationEmitErrors/when file with no error changes tscWatch:: Generates files matching the baseline

unittests:: tsbuildWatch:: watchMode:: programUpdates:: reports errors in all projects on incremental compile when declaration emit errors are present programUpdates reportErrors/declarationEmitErrors/when fixing error files all files are emitted tscWatch:: Generates files matching the baseline

unittests:: tsbuildWatch:: watchMode:: programUpdates:: reports errors in all projects on incremental compile when declaration emit errors are present when reporting errors on introducing error programUpdates reportErrors/declarationEmitErrors/introduceError/when file with no error changes tscWatch:: Generates files matching the baseline
